In addition, using a supplier-customer route incurs a fixed route activation cost, given in route_fixed_costs.csv, whenever any positive amount is shipped on that route.

Formulate a mixed-integer fixed-charge transportation model. For each supplier i and customer j, define x_ij as the quantity shipped from supplier i to customer j, and y_ij as a binary variable equal to 1 if route i-j is used and 0 otherwise. The objective is to minimize the sum of variable transportation costs and fixed route activation costs. The model should satisfy every customer's demand, ensure that total shipments from each supplier do not exceed its supply capacity, link shipment quantities to route-activation decisions, impose nonnegativity on shipment variables, and impose binary restrictions on the route-use variables.
